facts.text: Lincoln University of Missouri is one of Missouri's two Historically Black Colleges and Universities and the only HBCU in the nation founded by formerly enslaved Black soldiers.

sources.title: About Lincoln | Lincoln University of Missouri
sources.quote: Lincoln continues to honor its heritage as one of Missouri's two Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) and the only HBCU in the nation founded by formerly enslaved Black soldiers.
